summary.text: Will Davis is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 39th District since January 10, 2024.
The district covers Franklin County and part of Roanoke County.
The House profile lists Will Davis's occupation as attorney.

paragraphs.text: Will Davis was born in Roanoke, Virginia.
The profile lists Franklin County High School (1989), a B.A. in Economics from Bridgewater College (1993) and a J.D. from Regent University.
The profile lists Habitat for Humanity under memberships and affiliations.
Will Davis serves on the Courts of Justice and Finance committees.
